blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Accurate hippocampal segmentation can be a useful tool for diagnosing and monitoring neurological conditions such as Alzheimer's disease and epilepsy. While numerous automated segmentation methods exist, their clinical adoption remains limited. Reliable uncertainty assessment can enhance trust and facilitate clinical translation. This study evaluates ensembles of five heterogeneous hippocampal segmentation methods - InnerEye, ASHS, FastSurfer, HippoSeg, and FreeSurfer - across two dementia datasets and one epilepsy dataset. The sub-ensemble containing InnerEye, FastSurfer, and HippoSeg emerged as both accurate and efficient, highlighting the feasibility of balancing computational cost and performance. Additionally, ensemble-derived uncertainty quantification with sample variance, mutual information, and predictive entropy is shown to reduce inaccurate segmentations by flagging low-confidence cases, potentially providing a mechanism for automatically escalating ambiguous cases for expert assessment. Lastly, this study explores the downstream clinical utility of ensemble-derived uncertainty, finding a significant correlation with motion artefact severity and a modest contribution to Alzheimer's disease classification.
blocks.zh: 准确的河马分化可以成为诊断和监测阿尔茨海默病和癫痫等神经病症的有用工具. 虽然存在许多自动化分解方法,但它们在临床上的采用仍然有限。 可靠的不确定性评估可以增强信任,促进临床翻译。 本研究评价了五种不同的河马分化方法 -- -- 内眼、ASHS、FastSurfer、HippoSeg和FreeSurfer -- -- 跨越两个痴呆症数据集和一个癫痫数据集。 包含InnerEye,FastSurfer,和HippoSeg的子组合出现既准确又高效,突出了平衡计算成本和性能的可行性. 此外,以样本差异、相互信息、预测性等量化共同产生的不确定性,通过标出低信任度病例,可以减少不准确的分解,有可能为专家评估自动升级的模棱两可案例提供一个机制。 最后,本研究探讨综艺衍生的不确定性在临床上的下游作用,发现与动脉动严重性有重大关联,对阿尔茨海默氏病分类作用不大。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Hippocampal volume changes are associated with several neurological diseases such as Alzheimer’s and epilepsy ( Jack, 1994 ; Duan et al., 2020 ) . Accurate volumetric measurement can serve as a biomarker for diagnosis and disease monitoring ( Schuff et al., 2008 ; Briellmann et al., 2002 ) . While manual segmentation by an expert is still considered the gold standard, its time-consuming nature and the well-documented intra- and inter-reader variability remain significant limitations ( Boccardi and et al., 2015 ; Geuze et al., 2005 ) . Although a concerted effort has taken place to establish a harmonised protocol for manual hippocampal segmentation ( Frisoni and Jack, 2015 ) , multiple different protocols for hippocampal segmentation exist, complicating the notion of a ground truth segmentation ( Geuze et al., 2005 ) .
blocks.zh: Hippocampal体积变化与阿尔茨海默症和癫痫等几种神经病有关(Jack,1994年;Duan等人,2020年)。 准确的体积测量可作为诊断和疾病监测的生物标志(Shuff等人,2008年;Briellmann等人,2002年)。 虽然专家的人工分解仍被视为金本位,但其耗时性以及记录齐全的读者内部和读者间差异仍然是重大限制(Boccardi等人,2015年;Geuze等人,2005年)。 尽管已作出协调一致的努力,为手动河马分流制定协调一致的协议(Frisoni和Jack,2015年),但河马分流有多种不同的协议,使地面真理分流的概念复杂化(Geuze等人,2005年)。

blocks.en: Numerous methods for automatic hippocampus segmentations have been proposed, ranging from atlas-based approaches ( Dill et al., 2015 ) , to deep learning methods ( Schroder et al., 2023 ) . Despite the range of available methods, clinical adoption remains limited. Key concerns hindering the clinical translation of these tools include the risk of silent failure, and a lack of robustness to unexpected distribution shifts. Reliable uncertainty estimation can play a central role in strengthening the trustworthiness of these algorithms, e.g. by escalating uncertain cases for human review, and various approaches for assessing predictive uncertainty have been explored in the literature ( Abdar and et al., 2020 ) . While Bayesian neural networks offer the most principled framework for posterior approximation, they are often computationally prohibitive ( Abdar and et al., 2020 ) . Monte-Carlo Dropout and ensembles have emerged as practical methods for Bayesian approximation ( Lakshminarayanan et al., 2016 ; Gal and Ghahramani, 2015 ) . However, these approaches differ substantially in computational cost. Monte-Carlo sampling increases inference time through repeated stochastic forward passes, while ensemble-based uncertainty quantification (UQ) requires running multiple models or segmentation pipelines, making inference cost scale with ensemble size. This creates an important trade-off between uncertainty reliability, scalability, and computational efficiency, particularly when methods are deployed across large imaging cohorts or resource-constrained clinical environments. Beyond providing uncertainty estimation, ensemble methods consistently achieve superior performance over individual models, as repeatedly demonstrated by results from the Brain Tumor Image Segmentation Benchmark (BRATS) ( Menze and et al., 2015 ) and the White Matter Hyperintensity Segmentation Challenge ( Kuijf and et al., 2019 ) . Ensemble predictions can be aggregated through multiple strategies, with stacking of heterogeneous models proving highly effective and simple averaging providing a stable method for integrating their predictions ( Müller et al., 2022 ) . Although deep ensembles often outperform single models, their combined outputs are not automatically well-calibrated, even when each constituent network is well-calibrated on its own ( Wu and Gales, 2021 ; Rahaman and Thiery, 2021 ) . Calibration deteriorates further under distribution shift ( Ovadia et al., 2019 ) , a problem that has been traced in part to insufficient diversity among ensemble members ( Javanbakhat et al., 2024 ) . To counter this, the present study assesses the disagreement of deliberately heterogeneous segmentation methods and treats that disagreement itself as an uncertainty estimate, a strategy previously explored by Kofler et al. (2021) .
blocks.zh: 提出了许多自动河马分解方法,从地图集方法(Dill等人,2015年)到深层学习方法(Schroder等人,2023年)。 尽管现有方法多种多样,但临床收养仍然有限。 阻碍这些工具临床翻译的关键问题包括沉默失败的风险,以及缺乏对出乎意料的分布转移的稳健性. 可靠的不确定性估计可以在加强这些算法的可信赖性方面发挥核心作用,例如,将不确定的情况升级,供人类审查,文献中探讨了评估预测不确定性的各种办法(Abdar等人,2020年)。 虽然贝叶斯神经网络为后期近似提供了最原则性的框架,但它们在计算上往往令人望而却步(Abdar等人,2020年)。 Monte-Carlo Droppout和综艺节目已成为巴耶西亚近似方法(Lakshminarayanan等人,2016年;Gal和Ghahramani,2015年)。 然而,这些方法在计算成本方面差别很大。 Monte-Carlo采样通过重复的Stochastic前进路段增加推导时间,而基于综艺的不确定性量化(UQ)则需要运行多个模型或分块管线,以综艺大小的推导成本尺度. 这在不确定性的可靠性、可伸缩性和计算效率之间产生了重要的权衡,特别是在大规模成像群或资源紧张的临床环境中采用方法时。 除了提供不确定性估计外,综艺方法还不断实现优于单个模型的性能,脑肿瘤图像分解基准(BRATS)(Menze等人,2015年)和白色物质超强度分解挑战(Kuijf等人,2019年)的结果一再证明了这一点。 组合式预测可以通过多种策略加以汇总,各种模型的堆叠证明非常有效和简单平均,为综合其预测提供了稳定的方法(Müller等人,2022年)。 虽然深层综艺经常优于单项模式,但其综合产出并不会自动得到很好的校准,即使每个组成网络本身都有很好的校准(Wu and Gales, 2021; Rahaman and Thiery, 2021). 在分配转移(Ovadia等人,2019年)中,校准进一步恶化,这一问题部分是由于合唱团成员之间多样性不足造成的(Javanbakhat等人,2024年)。 为了解决这一问题,本研究报告评估了有意采取的各种分类方法的分歧,并将这种分歧本身视为一种不确定性估计,这是Kofler等人(2021年)先前探讨的一项战略。

blocks.en: Another growing concern is the computational cost and energy consumption of the segmentation methods. Recent work has highlighted the potential environmental impact of large-scale deep learning models ( Strubell et al., 2020 ; Wu and et al., 2022 ) , emphasizing the need for sustainable solutions. High computational demands not only contribute to a significant carbon footprint, but also limit accessibility for hospitals and research institutions with limited resources. Addressing both the need for reliable uncertainty estimation and computational efficiency will be conducive for enabling broader clinical adoption.
blocks.zh: 另外一个日益令人关切的问题是分化方法的计算成本和能量消耗。 最近的工作突出了大规模深入学习模式(Strubell等人,2020年;Wu等人,2022年)对环境的潜在影响,强调需要可持续的解决办法。 高计算需求不仅有助于形成巨大的碳足迹,而且限制了资源有限的医院和研究机构的无障碍环境。 解决可靠的不确定性估计和计算效率两方面的需要,将有助于更广泛地采用临床方法。

blocks.en:
Beyond performance accuracy, ensembling methods may prove useful to provide robust uncertainty estimates that can be employed for downstream clinical tasks. One such application relates to quality control and particularly motion artefact detection. There are a number of sources that can lead to motion artefacts in brain magnetic resonance imaging ( MRI ) , including patient movement, involuntary physiological motion (e.g., respiration and cardiac pulsation), swallowing, and flow of fluids such as blood or cerebrospinal fluid ( Zaitsev et al., 2015 ) . Motion artefacts can negatively impact image quality and lead to erroneous interpretations, in particular in acquisitions with low signal-to-noise ratio ( Havsteen et al., 2017 ) . Accurately detecting and correcting motion-related image degradation has long been a challenge in medical image processing ( Zaitsev et al., 2015 ) . While both traditional machine learning and deep-learning-based methods have demonstrated strong performance ( Vakli et al., 2023 ) , their effectiveness often does not generalise well across vendors or acquisition protocols.
Segmentation uncertainty, which tends to increase as image quality degrades, may therefore offer a complementary signal for flagging motion-corrupted scans, with previous work showing that ensemble-derived uncertainties are particularly useful for quality control ( Ng et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh:
除了性能准确性外,综艺方法可能证明有助于提供可用于下游临床任务的可靠的不确定性估计。 其中一种应用涉及质量控制,特别是运动动动动脉检查。 脑磁共振成像(核磁共振成像)中有多种来源可以导致运动文物,包括病人运动,非自愿生理运动(如呼吸和心脏脉冲),吞咽,血液或脑脊液等流体流动(Zaitsev等人,2015年). 运动文物可能对图像质量产生不利影响,并导致错误解释,特别是在信号与噪音比率较低的采购中(Havsteen等人,2017年)。 准确检测和纠正与运动相关的图像退化长期以来一直是医疗图像处理方面的挑战(Zaitsev等人,2015年)。 虽然传统的机器学习和深层学习方法都表现出了很强的性能(Vakli等人,2023年),但它们的效力往往不能在供应商或采购协议中很好地概括。
随着图像质量的退化,分解不确定性往往会增加,因此可以为标注运动腐蚀扫描提供补充信号,先前的研究表明,综艺衍生的不确定性对质量控制特别有用(Ng等人,2023年)。

blocks.en: A further potential application of uncertainty estimation in the context of hippocampal segmentation is disease classification. Previous work has shown that hippocampal volume can discriminate Alzheimer’s disease (AD) from mild cognitive impairment (MCI) and cognitively normal (CN) subjects with approximately 84% sensitivity and specificity ( Colliot et al., 2008 ) , and a recent meta-analysis of artificial intelligence ( AI ) -based methods-based methods reports high performance for AD vs. CN (sensitivity: 0.87, specificity: 0.91, AUC: 0.95), though accuracy decreases for AD vs. MCI (AUC: 0.80) and MCI vs. CN (AUC: 0.83) ( Wu et al., 2025 ) . Leveraging epistemic uncertainty, we hypothesise that disagreements between methods designed to accommodate atrophy and methods trained purely on healthy individuals will be stronger in the AD cases with stronger hippocampal atrophy. If confirmed, such disagreement could serve as an additional feature for classification.
blocks.zh: 在河马分化的背景下,不确定性估计的另一个潜在应用是疾病分类。 以往的研究表明,河马体体积可以将阿尔茨海默氏病区分为轻度认知障碍(MCI)和认知正常(CN)科目,敏感度和特异性约为84%(Colliot等人,2008年),最近对人工智能的元分析(AI)-基于方法的方法报告AD对CN的性能很高(敏感度:0.87,特异性:0.91,AUC:0.95),但AD对MCI(AUC:0.80)和MCI对CN(AUC:0.83)的精度下降。 我们假设,在适应萎缩症的方法和纯粹针对健康个体的训练方法之间,在具有较强的河马萎缩症的反倾销病例中,分歧会更大。 如果得到确认,这种分歧可作为分类的另一个特征。

blocks.en: 1.1 Contributions
blocks.zh: 1.1 缴款

blocks.en: Our contributions are three-fold. First, we provide a comprehensive benchmark of five heterogeneous hippocampal segmentation methods, evaluating their accuracy, calibration, and carbon footprint across two dementia cohorts and one epilepsy cohort. From this benchmark, we identify a resource-efficient triad — InnerEye, FastSurfer, and HippoSeg — that matches the full ensemble’s Dice performance while reducing inference CO 2 emissions by approximately 82 %, and show that simple averaging of probabilistic outputs yields the best integration strategy. Second, we demonstrate that uncertainty estimates derived from the triad’s probabilistic outputs can support automated quality control: aggregated uncertainty successfully flags gross segmentation failures across datasets, and correlates significantly with motion artefact severity, suggesting a mechanism for automatically escalating problematic cases for expert review. Third, we investigate the clinical utility of ensemble-derived uncertainty for disease classification, and show that combining uncertainty metrics with hippocampal volume features improves discrimination between cognitively normal and Alzheimer’s disease groups.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献有三个方面。 首先,我们提供了五种不同的河马分化方法的全面基准,评估其准确性、校准和碳足迹,涵盖两个痴呆群体和一个癫痫群体。 从这个基准中,我们确定了一个资源效率高的三合院 — — InnerEye、FastSurfer和HippoSeg — — 与全综艺的二合院性能相匹配,同时将推论CO 2 的排放量降低约 82%,并表明简单平均概率产出产生最佳整合战略。 第二,我们证明,三体概率输出产生的不确定性估计可以支持自动化的质量控制:汇总的不确定性成功地标记了数据集之间的总分解故障,并且与动动动动动动动严重性密切相关,建议建立一个机制,使问题案件自动升级,供专家审查。 第三,我们调查综艺衍生的不确定因素对疾病分类的临床作用,并表明,将不确定因素和河马体积特征结合起来,会改善认知正常和阿尔茨海默病群体之间的区别。

blocks.en: Five segmentation techniques were chosen to cover differences in techniques (atlas-based and deep-learning-based) and variation in training data (healthy controls, dementia, and epilepsy). An overview is provided in Table 1 . Notably, for ASHS we used the Penn Memory Center 3T ASHS Atlas for T1-weighted MRI ( Xie and et al., 2016 ) .

blocks.en: 2.2 Data
blocks.zh: 2.2 数据

blocks.en: Five datasets were used to assess the potential benefit of including uncertainty measures in three separate contexts: cross-domain segmentation performance with ground truth, motion artefact detection, and Alzheimer’s disease spectrum classification.
blocks.zh: 5个数据集用于评估在三个不同情况下纳入不确定性计量的潜在好处:具有地面真伪的跨域分解性能、运动动动脉动检测和阿尔茨海默氏病谱分类。

blocks.en: For the experiments on segmentation performance, hippocampal segmentations were performed on three independent datasets, for which gold standard manual segmentations were defined by a clinician with neuroradiology experience, and confirmed by a consultant neuroradiologist. The definition followed an amended version of the harmonised protocol definition to also include the fimbria ( Boccardi and et al., 2015 ) . The three datasets were:

blocks.en: : Thirty participants of the Alzheimer’s Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) (mean age 76.8 ± 7.3 years; 21 male, 9 female). T1-weighted images were acquired with voxel sizes approximately 1.2mm×0.9–1.3mm× 0.9–1.3mm, varying by acquisition site. One third were diagnosed with Alzheimer’s disease, one third with late mild cognitive impairment, and one third were cognitively normal. No subjects overlapped with those in the InnerEye training dataset.
blocks.zh: 阿尔茨海默氏病神经成像倡议的30名参与者(平均年龄76.8 ± 7.3岁;21名男性,9名女性)。 T1加权图像是用约1.2mmx0.9-1.3mmx 0.9-1.3mm获得的,因购置地点而异。 三分之一被诊断患有阿尔茨海默症,三分之一被诊断患有晚期轻度认知障碍,三分之一被诊断为认知正常。 与内眼培训数据集中的主题没有重叠.

blocks.en: Eight patients with temporal lobe epilepsy (mean age 46.8±24.9 years; 3 male, 5 female). MRI scans were acquired using a Siemens Prisma 3T scanner with an magnetization-prepared rapid gradient echo ( MPRAGE ) sequence and a voxel size of 1.1mm×1.1mm× 1.2mm. Ethical approval for the research study using this data was given through the hospital Data Access Process for Research (DAP-R ethics, University College London Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust (2024) ).
blocks.zh: 8名癫痫病人(平均年龄46.8±24.9岁;3名男性,5名女性)。 磁共振扫描是使用Siemens Prisma 3T扫描仪进行的,其磁化准备的快速梯度回声(MPRAGE)序列和阴道尺寸为1.1mmx1.1mmxxx 1.2毫米口径. 通过医院研究数据获取程序(DAP-R伦理,大学伦敦学院医院NHS基金会信托基金(2024年)),对利用这些数据进行研究的伦理认可。

blocks.en: Twenty-one patients referred to the dementia clinic (mean age 73.0 ± 14.5; 15 male, 6 female). MRI scans were acquired on a Siemens Prisma 3T scanner using an MPRAGE sequence with a voxel size of 1.1mm×1.1mm× 1.2mm. Ethical approval for the research study using this data was given through the hospital Data Access Process for Research (DAP-R ethics, University College London Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust (2024) ).
blocks.zh: 21名患者转诊痴呆症诊所(平均年龄73.0±14.5;15名男性,6名女性). 在Siemens Prisma 3T扫描仪上购买了核磁共振扫描仪,该扫描仪使用MPRAGE序列,其阴道尺寸为1.1mmx1.1mmxx 1.2毫米口径. 通过医院研究数据获取程序(DAP-R伦理,大学伦敦学院医院NHS基金会信托基金(2024年)),对利用这些数据进行研究的伦理认可。

blocks.en: For the motion artefact analysis, the publicly available Movement-Related Artefacts (MR-ART) dataset ( Nárai et al., 2022 ) was used. No ground truth segmentations were available for this dataset.
blocks.zh: 在运动动脉学分析中,使用了公开提供的与运动有关的动脉学数据集(Nárai等人,2022年)。 本数据集没有地面真相分解。

blocks.en: 148 healthy adults (age range 18–75 years, median 25.2 years; 53 male, 95 female) with no reported neurological or psychiatric conditions. MRI scans were acquired on a Siemens Magnetom Prisma 3T scanner using an MPRAGE sequence with isotropic 1 mm 3 resolution. For each participant, three T1-weighted scans were acquired: one motion-free (Standard), and two with induced head motion of increasing severity (HeadMotion1: 5 nods; HeadMotion2: 10 nods during acquisition). Each scan was assigned a clinical quality score by experienced neuroradiologists who were blind to the acquisition condition; following the original dataset definition, scans were rated on a three-point scale reflecting image quality from the point of view of clinical diagnostic use, as clinically good (score 1), medium (score 2), or bad (score 3), with bad-quality images considered unusable for clinical diagnostics (see supplementary fig. S5 ) . Of these, 100 participants across all three conditions were included in the analysis.
blocks.zh: 148名健康成年人(年龄在18-75岁之间,中位数为25.2岁;53名男性,95名女性),没有报告神经或精神疾病。 磁共振扫描是在西门子磁铁Prisma 3T扫描仪上使用具有异构1毫米3分辨率的MPRAGE序列获得的。 每名参与者都获得了3个T1加权扫描器:1个无运动(标准),2个有增重诱导头部运动(头部运动1:5点头;头部运动2:在获取过程中10点头). 每一次扫描均被经验丰富的神经辐射学家给定临床质量分数,他们对获取状况视而不见;按照原始数据集定义,扫描从临床诊断使用的角度将反映图像质量的三分尺度评为临床良好(分数1),中度(分数2),或差(分数3),质量不良的图像被认为无法用于临床诊断(见补充图). 页:1 其中,涉及所有三个条件的100名参与者参加了分析。

blocks.en: For the Alzheimer’s disease classification experiment, a separate, larger ADNI cohort was used. No ground truth manual segmentations were available for this cohort.
blocks.zh: 在阿尔茨海默氏病分类实验中,使用了一个单独的、更大的ADNI组群。 这批人没有地面真相手册。

blocks.en: 150 participants from the Alzheimer’s Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI), stratified by diagnosis: 50 cognitively normal (CN), 50 with mild cognitive impairment (MCI), and 50 with Alzheimer’s disease (AD) (mean age 73.0 ± 7.5 years, range 56–90; 75 male, 75 female). blocks.en: 2.3 Processing
blocks.zh: 2.3 处理

blocks.en: Inference for the ADNI dataset and MR-ART was performed on a high-performance computing (HPC) cluster. For carbon footprint benchmarking, the data was processed on a dedicated node equipped with 4 NVIDIA GTX 1080 Ti GPUs, an Intel Xeon E5-2640 v4 CPU (2.40GHz), and 64GB of RAM, with no concurrent jobs from other users. The local hospital data was processed entirely on a local MacBook Pro (Intel Core i5-5257U CPU @ 2.70 GHz, with ∼ \sim 8GB of memory) due to data sharing limitations in ethics. For fair comparison, same software versions were installed on the cluster and on the local machine. An older version of FreeSurfer (v6.0.0) was selected to accommodate the memory constraints of the local machine. FastSurfer (v2.3.3) was run from a Docker image on the local machine, and via Singularity (v3.8.5-2.el7) on the reserved cluster node. ASHS (v2.0.0, July 2018) was run natively on the respective host system. Because epilepsy can cause unilateral hippocampal atrophy the left and right hippocampi were processed separately to avoid averaging out potential differences in segmentation performance. This separation allows for evaluating whether some methods underperform specifically on the atrophied side. Energy consumption and time to completion was tracked with the Python package Codecarbon (v2.8.3). Carbon tracking was performed in machine mode on the dedicated cluster node, using the United Kingdom country-level grid intensity estimate available to CodeCarbon for the location of the datacenter. The reported values therefore represent inference emissions only, including CPU, GPU, and RAM energy during runtime, and do not include model training, data storage or transfer, hardware manufacturing, or other lifecycle emissions. CodeCarbon recorded a power usage effectiveness (PUE) of 1.0, so no additional data-centre cooling or infrastructure overhead was included. No additional pre-processing of the scans was performed prior to segmentation with the respective tool.

blocks.en: 2.5 Ensemble performance & calibration
blocks.zh: 2.5 组合性能和校准

blocks.en: Segmentation performance was evaluated using the Dice Similarity Coefficient (DSC) and the 95th percentile Hausdorff distance ( HD95 ), predictive uncertainty with sample variance, mutual information, and entropy, while uncertainty calibration was evaluated in terms of expected calibration error. As initial benchmarking, the five individual segmentation methods, all possible triads formed from them, and the full ensemble of five methods were compared on the ADNI dataset. The same ADNI dataset was therefore used both to identify the best-performing triad and to report its ADNI performance. Consequently, any performance advantage of the selected triad over other sub-ensembles on ADNI should be interpreted as an in-sample estimate that may be partially inflated by selection on the same data. The Local Dementia and Local Epilepsy datasets were not used for triad selection and therefore provide the held-out assessment of cross-domain segmentation performance and calibration. For each triad and for the full ensemble, the final prediction mask was obtained via majority voting. Performance was assessed in terms of DSC, ECE, and estimated CO 2 emissions. The expected calibration error (ECE) of each sub-ensemble was approximated by interpreting the number of votes from the T = 3 T=3 ensemble members as discrete confidence levels. Specifically, if n n models predicted the class hippocampus for a voxel v v , the ensemble confidence was defined as p v = n T p_{v}=\frac{n}{T} . For the winning triad, minor changes to their code were introduced to enable saving of the probabilistic outputs. The relevant amended scripts are publicly available on GitHub: https://github.com/zfdiwkm/multi-software-uncertainty.
blocks.zh: 利用Dice相似性系数(DSC)和第95百分位的Husdorf距离(HD95),以样本差异,相互信息,以及 en来评价分化性能,而不确定性校准则按照预期校准误差来评价. 作为初始基准,在ADNI数据集上比较了五种个别的分解方法,所有可能形成的三合体,以及五种方法的全部组合. 因此,同一ADNI数据集既用于确定表现最好的三体,也用于报告其ADNI性能. 因此,选定的三合唱团相对于ADNI上的其他次合唱团的任何性能优势应解释为一个抽样估计,通过在同一数据上进行选择,可能会部分夸大。 局部痴呆症和局部癫痫数据集没有用于三体选择,因此提供了跨域分解性能和校准的搁置评估. 每个三人组和全综艺节目,最后的预测口罩都是通过多数投票获得的. 对业绩的评估涉及DSC、欧洲经委会和CO2排放量估计数。 通过将T = 3 T = 3 共聚体成员的票数解释为离散信心水平,对每个分群的预期校准错误(ECE)进行了大致解释. 具体来说,如果 n 型号预测了 voxel v 的类河马座, 组合置信被定义为 p v = n T p_{v}=\frac{n}{T}. 对于获胜的三合会,对其代码进行了一些小的修改,以节省概率输出. 相关的修正脚本可在GitHub上公开查阅:https://github.com/zfdiwkm/多软件-不确定.

blocks.en: 2.5.1 Ensemble integration strategy
blocks.zh: 2.5.1 融合战略

blocks.en: Next, we compared different strategies for integrating the predictions of the best-performing triad to assess their impact on segmentation accuracy and uncertainty calibration. These ensemble strategies were: (1) simple averaging of the output probabilities from each ensemble member (denoted as ‘Ensemble Averaged’ in the results), (2) weighting each prediction by the model’s confidence (‘Ensemble Weighted’), and (3) assigning each voxel to the prediction of the most confident model in a winner-takes-all approach (‘Ensemble Triage’). Due to non-normality of studied distributions, Friedman tests were performed to assess significant difference in performance. To account for multiple comparisons, p-values were adjusted with the Holm-Bonferroni method. Resource consumption was estimated in terms of duration and CO 2 expenditure for each method and each subject.
blocks.zh: 其次,我们比较了综合最佳三体预测的不同战略,以评估其对分化准确性和不确定性校准的影响。 这些组合策略是:(1) 简单平均每个组合成员的产出概率(在结果中被指为 " 组合平均值 " ),(2) 通过模型的信心来权衡每个预测( " 组合加权值 " ),(3) 在赢家所有办法中将每个组合用于预测最有信心的模型( " 组合三角 " )。 由于所研究的分布不规则,弗里德曼进行了测试,以评估性能的巨大差异. 为了考虑多种比较,p值按照Holm-Bonferroni方法进行了调整. 资源消耗按期限和CO 2 支出估算,用于每种方法和每个科目。

blocks.en: 2.6 Uncertainty-based quality control
blocks.zh: 2.6 基于不确定性的质量控制

blocks.en: We investigated whether ensemble-derived uncertainty can support automated quality control, both by identifying unreliable segmentation outputs and by flagging low image quality cases.
blocks.zh: 我们调查了共同产生的不确定性能否通过查明不可靠的分块产出和标出低图像质量案例来支持自动化质量控制。

blocks.en: 2.6.1 Silent failure detection
blocks.zh: 2.6.1 静态故障探测

blocks.en: We evaluated whether hippocampus-wide aggregated uncertainty could serve as a predictor of low-quality segmentations. To this end, uncertainty values were aggregated across the region of interest (ROI), defined as the union of predicted segmentations with a one-voxel margin. Morphological dilation was performed once, with scipy.ndimage.binary_dilation with a square connectivity = 1 (6 connected kernel). The hippocampi with the highest uncertainty were excluded, and the resulting impact on segmentation performance was assessed to determine the method’s suitability for preventing silent failures. The threshold for exclusion was determined through the following steps: (A) classifying all predictions into ‘correct’ or ‘failed’ segmentations, with failed segmentations defined here as DSC < 0.82 or HD95 > 2.5 mm; (B) performing a stratified split of predictions into a validation set (30%) and a test set (70%); (C) conducting a grid search to identify the optimal threshold per dataset and metric by maximising the F1-score; and (D) applying the identified optimal threshold to the held-out test data.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了整个河马营的总体不确定性是否可以作为低质量分区的预测器。 为此,整个利益区(ROI)的不确定性值被汇总起来,被定义为预测的分块结合到一伏瑟尔比值. 口腔拓扑一次,有scipy.ndimage.binary_dilation的方形连接=1(6个连接内核). 不确定性最高的河马营被排除在外,因此对分化性能的影响进行了评估,以确定该方法是否适合防止无声故障。 排除阈值是通过下列步骤确定的:(A) 将所有预测分为 " 正确 " 或 " 失败 " 分区,在此将失败的分区定义为DSC < 0.82或HD95 > 2.5毫米;(B) 将预测分层分为验证组(30%)和测试组(70%);(C) 进行网格搜索,通过将F1分数最大化,确定每个数据集和度数的最佳阈值;(D) 将所确定的最佳阈值应用于搁置测试数据。

blocks.en: 2.6.2 Motion artefact detection
blocks.zh: 2.6.2 运动动脉学检测

blocks.en: We further assessed whether uncertainty correlates with image quality in the presence of motion artefacts. Using the MR-ART dataset, uncertainty metrics were computed for each hippocampus and grouped by the image quality score (1 = good, 2 = medium, 3 = bad) assigned by expert neuroradiologists. To test for a monotonic relationship between quality score and uncertainty, a within-subject permutation test was performed (10,000 permutations), using Spearman’s rank correlation as the test statistic. Quality score labels were permuted within each subject to preserve the repeated-measures structure. Pairwise comparisons (Score 2 vs 1; Score 3 vs 2) were conducted using Wilcoxon signed-rank tests on the subset of subjects with scans in both categories being compared (n = 37 and n = 43 subjects, respectively). For each subject, uncertainty values were averaged across hippocampi within each quality category prior to testing. P-values were adjusted for multiple comparisons using the Holm-Bonferroni method, applied across all six pairwise tests (3 metrics × \times 2 comparisons).
blocks.zh: 我们进一步评估了不确定性在运动文物面前是否与图像质量相关。 使用MR-ART数据集,计算了每个河马群的不确定性计量标准,并按照专家神经辐射学家分配的图像质量得分(1=好,2=中,3=差)进行分组. 为了测试质量得分和不确定性之间的单调关系,进行了一个主体内演化测试(10,000次演化),以斯皮尔曼的排名关联作为测试统计. 质量分数标签在每个科目中都进行渗透,以保留重复计量结构. 对等比较(Score 2 vs 1;Score 3 vs 2)是使用Wilcoxon签名对子科目进行排名测试,对两类科目进行扫描比较(n=37,n=43个科目)。 对于每个主体,在测试前,每个质量类别内各河马群的不确定性值均值。 对P值进行了调整,以便使用Holm-Bonferroni方法进行多重比较,并适用于所有六个双向测试(3个度量×\times 2比较)。

blocks.en: 2.7 Uncertainty for Alzheimer’s disease classification
blocks.zh: 2.7 阿尔茨海默氏病分类的不确定性

blocks.en: We investigated whether ensemble-derived uncertainty could improve classification of Alzheimer’s disease from hippocampal features. From the ADNI baseline stratified cohort, 150 subjects were selected with balanced representation across diagnostic groups (50 were cognitively normal, 50 with mild cognitive impairment, and 50 with Alzheimer’s disease). Hippocampal volumes were extracted from each segmentation method and normalised by intracranial volume (ICV), with ICV estimates provided by HIPPOSEG. Voxel-wise uncertainty metrics (sample variance, mutual information, and predictive entropy) were aggregated as the mean across the hippocampal ROI for each hemisphere, then averaged across hemispheres to yield subject-level features. This scalar aggregation was chosen to keep the feature space small relative to the cohort size and to reduce the risk of overfitting that would be introduced by higher-dimensional spatial uncertainty features. Age and sex were included as covariates. To assess the discriminative power brought by uncertainty estimates we compared models including individual and combined uncertainty estimates to a model based only on volumetric input. Classification methods included logistic regression, Random Forest, and support vector machine classifiers, with 5×5 repeated stratified k-fold cross-validation (25 total folds). Three binary classification tasks were evaluated: CN vs AD, CN vs MCI, and MCI vs AD. Performance was assessed using the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) and balanced accuracy. Statistical comparison of feature sets against the volume-only baseline was performed using a permutation test (10,000 permutations), with 95% confidence intervals estimated via bootstrap resampling.
blocks.zh: 我们调查了综艺衍生的不确定性是否能改善从河马特征对阿尔茨海默氏病的分类。 从ADNI的基线分级组群中,有150个学科被选中,诊断组群的代表性均衡(50个学科是认知正常的,50个有轻微认知障碍,50个学科是阿尔茨海默病)。 Hippocampal体积从每一种分解法中提取出来,并按颅内体积(ICV)正常化,ICV的估算由HIPPOSEG提供. Voxel-wiside的不确定性衡量标准(样本差异、相互信息、预测性肽)作为每个半球的河马区ROI平均值汇总,然后在半球之间平均得出主题一级特征。 选择这种缩放是为了使特征空间相对于组群大小保持小,并减少由高维空间不确定性特征带来的过于适应的风险。 年龄和性别被列为共同变量。 为了评估不确定性估计带来的歧视性力量,我们将包括个人和综合不确定性估计在内的模型与仅基于量性投入的模型进行比较。 分类方法包括后勤回归、随机森林和支持矢量机分类器,有5×5次重复分级的k倍交叉验证(共25个折叠)。 评估了三个二进制分类任务:CN vs AD,CN vs MCI,和MCI vs AD. 利用接收器操作特征曲线(AUC)下的区域和平衡的准确度评估了性能。 利用演化测试(10 000次演化),对特征集与仅容积基线进行了统计比较,通过靴子重新取样估计了95%的置信间隔。

blocks.en: 3.3 Uncertainty for Alzheimer’s disease classification

blocks.en: Adding uncertainty metrics to hippocampal volume features did modestly improve classification of Alzheimer’s disease. For CN vs AD classification, the volume-only baseline ( total intracranial volume ( TIV ) -normalized bilateral hippocampal volume with age and sex covariates) achieved an AUC of 0.81 ± 0.04. The best-performing model (Full_mean, logistic regression) achieved AUC 0.87 ± 0.03, representing a modest improvement of +0.06 (permutation test, p < 0.001; Fig. 6 ). In practical terms, using the Full_mean feature set led to one additional subject (out of 49) being correctly identified as AD and four additional subjects (out of 48) being correctly identified as CN (Fig. 7 ). Adding any individual uncertainty feature to volume (Vol+UQ variants) provided no benefit over volume alone ( Δ \Delta AUC ≈ \approx 0, p > 0.05). For CN vs MCI (baseline AUC 0.73) and MCI vs AD (baseline AUC 0.70) classifications, uncertainty features consistently were unable to improve predictive performance ( supplementary figures S1 , S3 , S2 and S4 ).

blocks.en: 4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: The current study comprehensively evaluated ensembles of heterogeneous hippocampal segmentation methods, and proposes the triad of InnerEye, FastSurfer, and HippoSeg as the optimal combination for achieving high segmentation performance while minimising resource cost and maintaining good calibration. This ensemble significantly outperformed all individual methods, while also producing well-calibrated uncertainty estimates across three independent datasets. We demonstrated that aggregating ensemble-derived uncertainty values can be useful for catching low-quality predictions, highlighting the potential for reliable uncertainty estimation to reduce the risk of silent failures in a clinical setting. Further, we showed that uncertainty measures increase as image quality degrades due to motion artefacts, opening up the possibility of utilising uncertainty for quality control.
blocks.zh: 目前的研究全面评估了各种河马分化方法的组合,并提议将内眼、FastSurfer和HippoSeg三合一作为实现高分化性能的最佳组合,同时尽量减少资源成本并保持良好的校准。 这一组合大大超过所有个别方法,同时在三个独立数据集中得出精确的不确定性估计。 我们证明,集合综合衍生的不确定性值对获取低质量预测可能有用,突出表明可靠的不确定性估计有可能减少临床环境中无声故障的风险。 此外,我们显示,随着图像质量因运动工艺品而退化,不确定性措施增加,从而有可能利用不确定性进行质量控制。

blocks.en: 4.1 Ensemble performance & computational cost
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 组合性能和计算成本

blocks.en: In our experiment assessing the computational cost of inference with a multi-software ensemble, we showed that the choice of ensemble members can have a strong impact on both performance and CO 2 emissions. While previous studies have often focused on the computational cost of training ( Selvan et al., 2022 ) , the cost of inference should also be considered due to its recurring nature. Architectural and design choices have been systematically shown to strongly influence the computational cost that accrues over time ( Prajwal et al., 2025 ) , and the results of our experiment further underscore the importance of benchmarking CO 2 emissions and identifying the best-performing compromise between resource cost and performance in medical image analysis, which may be particularly relevant in resource-constraint hospital settings. This comparison should be interpreted as a within-study inference benchmark on a fixed hardware and energy-mix setting, rather than as a full lifecycle carbon assessment or as a comparison with substantially larger models. The approximately 82% reduction reflects the exclusion of the two most computationally expensive tools, ASHS and FreeSurfer, relative to the five-tool ensemble on the ADNI-30 benchmark. Other efficient paradigms, including lightweight or parameter-efficient architectures such as neural cellular automata, may offer further reductions and could be valuable components of future ensembles. Further, our comparison of ensemble integration strategies showed that simple mean averaging performed best, consistent with prior findings by Müller et al. (2022) .
blocks.zh: 在我们评估用多软件组合推论的计算成本的实验中,我们显示,组合成员的选择可对性能和二氧化碳2排放量产生很大影响。 虽然以往的研究往往侧重于培训的计算成本(Selvan等人,2022年),但由于其反复出现的性质,推断的成本也应予以考虑. 建筑和设计方面的选择被系统地证明对随着时间的推移积累的计算成本具有很大影响(Prajwal等人,2025年),我们的实验结果进一步突出了确定二氧化碳排放基准和确定医疗图像分析中资源成本与绩效之间最佳的妥协的重要性,这可能与资源制约的医院环境特别相关。 这种比较应解释为关于固定硬件和能量混合设置的研究内推论基准,而不是作为整个生命周期的碳评估或与大得多的模型的比较。 大约82%的降幅表明,相对于ADNI-30基准上的五个工具组合,两个最昂贵的计算工具ASHS和FreeSurfer被排除在外。 其他高效的范式,包括轻量级或参数效率高的架构,如神经细胞自动机,可能会进一步减少,并且可能成为未来综艺节目的宝贵组成部分. 此外,我们对综艺融合战略的比较表明,简单平均表现最佳,符合Müller等人(2022年)先前的调查结果。

blocks.en: 4.2 Uncertainty-based quality control
blocks.zh: 4.2 基于不确定性的质量控制

blocks.en: 4.2.1 Silent failure detection
blocks.zh: 4.2.1 国家 静态故障检测

blocks.en: Our finding that aggregated uncertainty can be used to detect silent failures is in line with previous reports in the literature ( Hoebel et al., 2019 ) ( Sander et al., 2020 ) . A limitation of the presented UQ-based failure detection is the modest precision of ∼ \sim 40%, which may translate into a high review burden for clinicians. However, comparable approaches show similar trade-offs. For example, Specktor-Fadida et al. (2025) trained a separate deep learning model for quality control and reported recall and precision of 0.74 and 0.55, respectively, for fetal brain segmentations. In our experiment, the entropy-based detector achieved high recall (91.7%) at the cost of lower precision (44.2%), flagging up to 35% of cases for manual review. This means that, in a cohort of 100 scans, approximately 35 segmentations would require inspection, of which roughly 15 would be true failures (defined in section 2.6.1 as DSC < 0.82 or HD95 > 2.5 mm) and 20 would be false alarms. The efficiency advantage of such a system therefore depends on the ratio between the time required to review and correct a flagged automatic segmentation and the time required for fully manual annotation. Moreover, uncertainty maps can be helpful in the correction phase by highlighting the regions with high uncertainty to the clinician. While automatic segmentation with manual corrections can thereby be time-efficient compared to fully manual segmentation ( Sander et al., 2020 ) , future work should aim to improve the precision of silent failure detection to further reduce the clinician burden. More broadly, the rate of segmentations flagged for manual review, which has been reported as up to 48% in previous work by Ng et al. (2023) , and up to 35% in our experiment, motivates further research into uncertainty-based failure detection that creates smaller overhead for the reviewing clinician.
blocks.zh: 我们关于可以用来检测无声故障的汇总不确定性的结论与文献中之前的报告(Hoebel等人,2019年)(Sander等人,2020年)是一致的. 所介绍的基于UQ的故障检测的一个局限性是\\sim 40%的微小精度,这可能会转化为临床医生的重审负担. 然而,类似的办法也显示出类似的权衡。 例如,Specktor-Fadida等人(2025年)为质量控制培训了一个单独的深层学习模式,并报告胎儿脑分裂的召回和精度分别为0.74和0.55。 在我们的实验中,以精度较低(44.2%)为代价,以肽为基础的探测器实现了高召回率(91.7%),将高达35%的病例标注在手工审查上。 这意味着,在100个扫描组中,大约35个区段需要检查,其中大约15个是真正的故障(在第2.6.1节中定义为DSC < 0.82或HD95 > 2.5毫米),20个是假警报。 因此,这种系统的效率优势取决于审查和纠正标记的自动分区所需时间与完全人工注释所需时间之间的比例。 此外,不确定性图通过向临床医生强调具有高度不确定性的区域,有助于纠正阶段的工作。 虽然与完全人工分解相比,自动分解与人工分解可以因此具有时间效率(Sander等人,2020年),但今后的工作应当着眼于提高无声故障检测的精度,以进一步减轻临床医生的负担。 更宽泛地说,Ng等人(2023年)在前一次工作中报告为48%,在我们实验中则报告为35%。

blocks.en: 4.2.2 Motion artifact detection
blocks.zh: 4.2.2 运动文物探测

blocks.en: While deep-learning methods for MRI segmentation can be more robust to motion-induced artefacts than traditional approaches, undersegmentation due to low image quality remains an issue ( Kemenczky et al., 2022 ) . Shaw et al. (2021) proposed a cascading student–teacher CNN to predict uncertainty maps specific to different artefact sources, including motion. They aggregate the predicted artefact uncertainty into a scalar QC score and show it correlates strongly with human ratings of segmentation quality on real-world low-quality scans (Spearman ρ = − 0.745 \rho=-0.745 ). This is consistent with our finding that uncertainty increases with degraded image quality. The stronger association reported by Shaw et al. (2021) might reflect the benefit of a model architecture specifically designed to predict uncertainty. Future work could further evaluate uncertainty against task-quality endpoints rather than scan-quality labels.
blocks.zh: 虽然与传统方法相比,核磁共振分解的深层学习方法对运动引起的人工制品更为有力,但由于图像质量低而造成的分解仍然是一个问题(Kemenczky等人,2022年)。 Shaw等人(2021年)提出一个连锁学生-教师CNN来预测包括运动在内的不同动脉源特有的不确定性地图. 它们将预测的动脉不确定性汇总到一个Scalar QC分数中,并显示它与人类在现实世界低质量扫描中分化质量的评级密切相关(Spearman ë = − 0.745\rho=-0.745)。 这符合我们的结论,即不确定性随着图像质量的退化而增加。 Shaw等人(2021年)报告的更强有力的关联可能反映了专门用来预测不确定性的模型架构的好处。 今后的工作可以进一步对照任务质量终点而不是扫描质量标签来评价不确定性。

blocks.en: 4.3 Uncertainty for Alzheimer’s disease classification
blocks.zh: 4.3 阿尔茨海默氏病分类的不确定性

blocks.en: Regarding the utility of ensemble-derived uncertainty for downstream classification, adding uncertainty metrics to hippocampal volume features did modestly improve discrimination between CN and AD subjects. Previous work by Philps et al. (2025) also showed that incorporating uncertainty into a downstream clinical task can improve classifier performance. In contrast to the present study, they not only aggregated uncertainty maps into a scalar value but also derived additional spatial features, such as the number of connected uncertainty components. Future work could investigate whether extracting more complex features from uncertainty maps further increases the added value of uncertainty for classification tasks.
blocks.zh: 关于共同衍生的不确定性对下游分类的效用,在河马体体积特征中增加不确定性的衡量标准,确实在一定程度上改善了氯化萘与反倾销学科之间的区别。 Philps等人先前的工作(2025年)也表明,将不确定性纳入下游临床任务可以提高分类器的性能. 与本研究形成对比的是,它们不仅将不确定性图汇总成一个标尺值,而且还衍生出额外的空间特征,如连接的不确定性元件的数量. 今后的工作可以调查从不确定性图中提取更复杂的特征是否进一步提高不确定性对分类任务的附加值。

blocks.en: 4.4 Uncertainty decomposition
blocks.zh: 4.4 (中文(简体) ). 不确定的分解

blocks.en: On the topic of uncertainty decomposition it has to be noted that the current study does not make strong claims about the type of uncertainty captured by the presented methods. Traditionally, uncertainty is separated in aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty, where ensemble-derived uncertainty metrics are viewed to focus more on the epistemic uncertainty. Changes in image quality - themselves increasing aleatoric uncertainty - can however also present a distribution shift that may then result in higher ensemble disagreement if the resulting discrepancy to the training data varies between the ensemble members. Consequently, the ensemble derived metrics (entropy, variance, and mutual information) cannot be easily mapped onto aleatoric or epistemic origin.
blocks.zh: 关于不确定性分解问题,必须指出的是,目前的研究没有对所介绍方法所抓住的不确定性类型提出强烈主张。 传统上,不确定性是分在感官不确定性和感官不确定性中的,其中综观衍生的不确定性衡量标准更注重感官不确定性. 然而,图像质量的变化----本身会增加疲软性的不确定性----也可能造成分布的转变,如果由此产生的与培训数据的差异在综艺成员之间出现差异,则可能造成更大的差异。 因此,组合衍生的计量标准(线性、差异和相互信息)无法轻易地映射到发育或癫痫起源。

blocks.en: 4.5 Limitations
blocks.zh: 4.5 限制

blocks.en: Several limitations of this study should be acknowledged. First, the sample sizes were relatively small, particularly for the local epilepsy dataset (n=8), which limits the generalisability of the findings. Second, with respect to identifying the optimal ensemble members, it should be noted that the triad was selected and evaluated on partly overlapping data (ADNI dataset), which may have introduced selection bias. Third, the use of FreeSurfer v6.0.0 may have introduced a potential confound when comparing FreeSurfer against the other methods, as performance differences may partly reflect version-specific effects rather than the underlying algorithm alone. Fourth, we did not evaluate the broader family of uncertainty-aware segmentation models, such as Probabilistic U-Net, PhiSeg, variational inference-based methods, or stochastic segmentation networks. These approaches may capture spatially structured segmentation ambiguity more directly than post hoc ensemble disagreement. Future work should compare this pragmatic ensemble-based approach against specialised probabilistic architectures. Another limitation of the present work is that it focuses exclusively on post-hoc methods for uncertainty estimation. The advantage of post-hoc methods is that the ensemble members can be replaced easily, should better segmentation models become available, which potentially makes these methods more attractive for clinical translation due to ease of implementation as well as future-proofing. However, it is acknowledged that segmentation robustness might benefit from incorporating uncertainty in the training process, which future work might want to explore.
blocks.zh: 应当承认这一研究的一些局限性。 首先,样本的大小相对较小,尤其是局部癫痫数据集(n=8),限制了调查结果的通用性。 第二,关于确定最佳组合成员的问题,应当指出,三合会是根据部分重叠的数据(ADNI数据集)选定和评价的,这可能引入了选择偏差。 第三,使用FreeSurfer v6.0.0可能会在比较FreeSurfer与其他方法时引入一个潜在的困惑,因为性能差异可能部分地反映版本特定效果,而不是仅反映基础算法. 第四,我们没有评估具有不确定性的分化模型的更广泛的家族,例如概率U-Net、PhiSeg、基于推论的变异方法、或结构分化网络。 这些方法可能比临时组合的分歧更直接地反映空间结构划分模糊性。 今后的工作应当将这种务实的综艺办法与专门概率结构相比较。 目前工作的另一个局限性是,它完全侧重于不确定性估算的事后方法。 后浩克方法的优点是,一旦有了更好的分化模型,综艺成员可以轻松地被替换,这有可能使这些方法对临床翻译更具吸引力,因为易于实施以及未来防疫. 然而,人们承认,将不确定性纳入培训进程可能会有利于分化的稳健性,而今后的工作可能要探讨这一点。

blocks.en: We further did not compare ensemble disagreement with alternative post-hoc, model-agnostic approaches, such as temperature scaling ( Guo et al., 2017 ) or conformal prediction. Conformal methods for semantic segmentation can transform model outputs into set-valued predictions with statistical risk or coverage guarantees, providing a principled alternative to ensemble disagreement as a proxy for uncertainty ( Mossina et al., 2024 ) . These guarantees require a representative held-out calibration set and rely on exchangeability between calibration and test data. Future work should directly compare these approaches in terms of calibration, failure detection, robustness to distribution shift, and computational cost.
blocks.zh: 我们还没有将总体差异与备选的后热、模型不可知方法进行比较,如温度缩放(Guo等人,2017年)或一致性预测。 语义分解的正规方法可以将模型输出转化为有统计风险或覆盖保障的设定值预测,作为不确定性的代名词,为共和分歧提供了一个原则性替代(Mossina等人,2024年)。 这些保证需要一套具有代表性的预留校准,并依靠校准和测试数据之间的可交换性。 今后的工作应在校准、故障检测、稳健到分配转移和计算成本方面直接比较这些方法。

blocks.en: While AECE is more suitable for skewed confidence distributions than standard ECE, it still has important limitations ( Nixon et al., 2019 ) . AECE can remain sensitive to the choice of bin count, which was addressed in the current work by evaluating multiple bin counts. Moreover, collapsing model calibration into a single value risks concealing patterns of over- and underconfidence across confidence ranges, as errors can cancel out within individual bins.
blocks.zh: 虽然ACECE比标准ECE更适合扭曲的信心分配,但它仍然有重要的局限性(Nixon等人,2019年). ACEC可以保持对选择bin计数的敏感性,在当前的工作中通过评价多个bin计数来解决. 此外,将模型校准成单一价值,有可能掩盖整个信任范围过度和缺乏信心的模式,因为错误可能消除个人内的错误。

blocks.en: Lastly, in the classification experiment, voxel-wise uncertainty maps were aggregated into a single scalar value per hippocampus, thereby discarding spatial patterns of uncertainty. This loss of spatial information may partly explain the mixed findings in the experiment on disease group classification, and future work could investigate whether more complex uncertainty features that incorporate spatial structure carry additional discriminative value for downstream clinical tasks.
blocks.zh: 最后,在分类实验中,Voxel-with的不确定性图被汇总为每个河马群的单级标值,从而抛弃了不确定性的空间规律. 这种空间信息丢失可能部分地解释了疾病组分类实验中的混合发现,今后的工作可以调查包含空间结构的更复杂的不确定性特征是否为下游临床任务带来额外的歧视性价值.

blocks.en: 4.6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4.6 结论

blocks.en: In conclusion, the evaluated triad-ensemble offers a practical compromise between segmentation accuracy, uncertainty calibration, and computational cost, reducing CO 2 emissions by approximately 82 % compared to the full five-method ensemble. Entropy-based uncertainty aggregation provides a useful mechanism for flagging potential segmentation failures. For downstream clinical tasks, uncertainty shows promise for detecting motion artefact severity, as well as adding modest improvements in predictive power in Alzheimer’s classification. Future work will investigate more complex uncertainty derived features to potentially further aid classification, as well as incorporating longitudinal data, to investigate the potential of UQ-supported detection of hippocampal atrophy.
blocks.zh: 总之,经评估的三合一在分化准确性、不确定性校准和计算成本之间提供了实际的妥协,与完整的五合一方法相比,二氧化碳排放量减少了约82%。 基于Entropy的不确定性汇总为标出潜在的分解失败提供了一个有用的机制. 在下游的临床任务中,不确定性显示出检测运动动动脉严重性的前景,以及增加阿尔茨海默分类中预测力的微小改善。 今后的工作将调查更复杂的不确定性衍生特征,从而有可能进一步进行援助分类,并纳入纵向数据,以调查UQ支持的海马萎缩探测的潜力。
